name: truthlens-bundled-samples
provenance: Six samples shipped with the repository in public/samples/. Each file comes from a DIFFERENT source, so each source is its own dataset group — this is what keeps near-duplicates out of any split. Generated by scripts/make-samples.mjs.

entries.note: Untouched camera capture with original EXIF.
Second camera capture, different scene and lens.
Whole-frame generated PNG; carries a generator marker.
Authentic frame with a pasted region — spatial edit, not generation.
Face region replaced over an authentic background.
Portrait that fills the frame; face-vs-frame checks are self-referential here and are skipped by design.
